MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk card fits my repeated purchases of removable storage; I can use spare capacity in a compatible device, and the adapter adds practical value.",
    "The HDMI cable fits my pattern of buying useful connections for equipment I already own, and its length could give me more placement flexibility."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks add entertainment devices without addressing a current need; 4K capability is also of little use with my listed 720p TV.",
    "The older Fire tablet feels unnecessary because I already bought a newer Fire 7 and accessories for it.",
    "The speaker, earbuds, smart plug, and Wi-Fi extender solve needs I have not expressed through my purchases or current circumstances."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as interest in more Amazon devices, although my follow-up purchases supported the tablet I already had.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in gadgets, when the particular function and compatibility matter much more to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy practical accessories such as memory cards, mounts, cables, storage cases, and camera supplies to support existing equipment.",
    "My latest purchase was a camera lens cap, which gives more reason to consider camera accessories than voice-controlled home devices.",
    "Buying outlet strips does not mean I need smart switching, just as owning a TV does not mean I currently need a streaming device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in electronics but missed that my current choices mostly support equipment I already own with compatible, practical accessories."
}
